title: Permissions required for an action
description: Determines the minimum RBAC permissions required to perform a specific Azure operation, supporting least-privilege design.
example_prompt: "What is the minimum RBAC role or specific permissions needed to perform: '{operation_description}'? Show: (1) required resource provider operations (e.g., Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action), (2) matching built-in role(s), (3) if no exact match, a custom role definition JSON with minimum permissions."
